About Tic-tac-toe

The classic starter game: nine squares, two symbols, three in a line wins. With perfect play it always draws, which makes it a great way to teach turn-taking and thinking one move ahead.

JoyFlock adds an easy computer opponent, private friend rooms and animated, audible moves.

How to play

  1. Take turns tapping an empty cell of the 3×3 grid, placing X or O.
  2. First to three matching symbols in a row, column or diagonal wins.
  3. A full grid with no line is a draw.

Frequently asked questions

The easy bot blocks obvious lines but does not punish every mistake, so a careful player can still win.
